title: Add support for `.opus` audio files

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
This PR implements https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/15584 by adding `AudioStreamOpus`, `AudioStreamPlaybackOpus` and `ResourceImporterOpus`. I have tested it on Windows and it works for all sample files at https://filesamples.com/formats/opus. ### Dependencies It adds the following thirdparty dependencies: - [xiph/opus](https://github.com/xiph/opus) - [xiph/opusfile](https://github.com/xiph/opusfile) The stream implementations of the PR are based on @mortarroad's PR in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/47114, although I had to modify them significantly. ### Screenshots
Click to expand
### Why? Without Opus, you have to use: - WAV - not compressed, unsuitable for long audio files. - Quite OK Audio is worse than Opus in every way except for CPU performance. - MP3 - released 34 years ago, very outdated compression, and [can't be looped seamlessly due to padding](https://sound.stackexchange.com/questions/25846/is-it-possible-to-loop-mp3-without-gaps). - Ogg Vorbis - released 26 years ago, outdated compression compared to Opus. In contrast, Opus is only 13 years old, with low latency and excellent compression. While most audio files on the internet are not using Opus, it's common for a file to be offered in WAV, which the Godot developer then has to convert to MP3/Vorbis to get a reasonable source control size. These files could be better compressed as Opus. The proposal in https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/6440 has 49 'likes' (compared to 1 'dislike') which shows others are interested in this. ### Footnotes Even though Opus files can be stored in `.ogg` containers, they need to be renamed to `.opus` to work with this PR. The impact on binary size of this PR is small: - Uncompressed: `182,486 KB` -> `182,719 KB` (increase: `233 KB`) - Compressed: `83,575 KB` -> `83,695 KB` (increase: `120 KB`) It may be possible to further reduce the binary size by removing unwanted files from xiph/opus and xiph/opusfile. I'm new to this so please let me know if I've done something wrong! :) - *Bugsquad edit:* This PR closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/15584
